points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗出生于古巴比那尔德里奥省的一个富裕甘蔗种植园主家庭。他接受了良好的教育，先后在耶稣会学校、古巴最好的学校之一贝伦学院和哈瓦那大学学习法律。在大学期间，他积极参与政治活动，对古巴的社会不平等和美国对古巴的经济控制感到不满。这一时期，他形成了强烈的民族主义和反美情绪，为后来的政治生涯奠定了思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: Fidel Castro was born in Birán, Mayabeque Province, Cuba, to a wealthy sugarcane farmer family. He received an excellent education, attending Jesuit schools, Belén School, and later studying law at the University of Havana. During his university years, he actively engaged in politics, developing strong anti-imperialist and anti-American sentiments due to his dissatisfaction with Cuba's social inequality and US economic control. This period shaped his nationalist ideology and laid the foundation for his future political career.

points.title: 革命启蒙
points.description: 1953年7月26日，卡斯特罗领导了针对蒙卡达兵营的武装起义，试图推翻巴蒂斯塔独裁政权。起义失败后，卡斯特罗被捕并受审，他在法庭上发表了著名的'历史将宣判我无罪'的演讲。随后被判处15年监禁，但在1955年大赦中获得释放。在狱中，他撰写了《历史将宣判我无罪》的辩护词，系统阐述了他的政治理念，成为后来古巴革命的重要思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: On July 26, 1953, Castro led an armed attack on the Moncada Barracks in an attempt to overthrow the Batista dictatorship. After the failed attack, Castro was arrested and tried, delivering his famous speech 'History Will Absolve Me.' He was sentenced to 15 years in prison but was pardoned in 1955. During his imprisonment, he wrote his defense speech, which later became the ideological foundation of the Cuban Revolution.

points.title: 流亡与准备
points.description: 获释后，卡斯特罗流亡墨西哥，在那里他结识了切·格瓦拉和其他革命者。1956年11月25日，卡斯特罗率领81名追随者乘坐'格拉玛号'游艇从墨西哥出发，于12月2日在古巴奥连特省登陆。尽管大部分人在登陆后不久就牺牲了，但幸存者包括卡斯特罗、格瓦拉和卡米洛·西恩富戈斯等人在马埃斯特拉山区建立了革命根据地。经过近三年的游击战，卡斯特罗领导的革命军逐渐壮大，最终在1959年1月1日推翻了巴蒂斯塔政权。
points.descriptionEn: After his release, Castro went into exile in Mexico, where he met Che Guevara and other revolutionaries. On November 25, 1956, Castro led 81 followers aboard the Granma yacht from Mexico, landing in Cuba's Oriente Province on December 2. Although most were killed shortly after landing, survivors including Castro, Guevara, and Camilo Cienfuegos established a revolutionary base in the Sierra Maestra mountains. After nearly three years of guerrilla warfare, Castro's revolutionary forces grew and eventually overthrew the Batista regime on January 1, 1959.

points.title: 革命胜利
points.description: 革命胜利后，卡斯特罗成为古巴的实际领导人。他迅速推行了一系列社会改革，包括土地改革、教育普及和医疗体系改革。1959年5月，他成立了革命法庭，审判了巴蒂斯塔政权的许多官员。1960年，古巴开始实行国有化政策，将美国和外国企业收归国有，这导致美国与古巴关系急剧恶化。1961年4月，美国支持的猪湾入侵失败，进一步巩固了卡斯特罗的地位，也促使他宣布古巴为社会主义国家。
points.descriptionEn: After the revolutionary victory, Castro became Cuba's de facto leader. He quickly implemented a series of social reforms, including land reform, education expansion, and healthcare system improvements. In May 1959, he established revolutionary tribunals to try officials of the Batista regime. In 1960, Cuba began nationalizing American and foreign-owned enterprises, leading to a sharp deterioration in US-Cuba relations. The failed Bay of Pigs invasion in April 1961 further consolidated Castro's position and led him to declare Cuba a socialist state.

points.title: 冷战对抗
points.description: 1962年古巴导弹危机使卡斯特罗成为全球焦点，他在美苏对峙中扮演了关键角色。在此期间，卡斯特罗与苏联建立了紧密联盟，接受了苏联的经济和军事援助。他推行了彻底的社会主义改造，建立了计划经济体制。1965年，他创建了古巴共产党，并担任第一书记。在冷战期间，卡斯特罗积极支持世界各地的革命运动，包括安哥拉、埃塞俄比亚等国的冲突。同时，他也在国内推行了一系列社会政策，使古巴的教育和医疗水平在拉丁美洲名列前茅，但也面临经济困难和政治压制的问题。
points.descriptionEn: The 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis brought Castro global prominence as he played a key role in the US-Soviet standoff. During this period, Castro established a close alliance with the Soviet Union, receiving economic and military aid. He implemented comprehensive socialist reforms, establishing a planned economy. In 1965, he founded the Communist Party of Cuba and became its First Secretary. Throughout the Cold War, Castro actively supported revolutionary movements worldwide, including conflicts in Angola and Ethiopia. Meanwhile, he implemented social policies that made Cuba's education and healthcare systems among the best in Latin America, though the country also faced economic difficulties and political repression.

points.title: 晚年与过渡
points.description: 2006年7月，卡斯特罗因健康原因将权力移交给弟弟劳尔·卡斯特罗。尽管他逐渐淡出公众视野，但仍偶尔发表文章和意见。2011年，古巴共产党第六次代表大会正式确认劳尔为最高领导人。卡斯特罗晚年见证了美古关系的部分正常化，2014年两国宣布恢复外交关系，2015年美国重新开放驻古巴大使馆。2016年11月25日，卡斯特罗在哈瓦那去世，享年90岁。他的去世标志着一个时代的结束，但他的政治遗产和对古巴的深远影响持续至今。
points.descriptionEn: In July 2006, Castro transferred power to his brother Raúl Castro due to health issues. Although he gradually faded from public view, he occasionally wrote articles and expressed opinions. In 2011, the 6th Congress of the Communist Party of Cuba formally confirmed Raúl as the top leader. In his later years, Castro witnessed the partial normalization of US-Cuba relations, with the countries announcing the restoration of diplomatic relations in 2014 and the US reopening its embassy in Cuba in 2015. On November 25, 2016, Castro died in Havana at the age of 90. His death marked the end of an era, but his political legacy and profound impact on Cuba continue to this day.

appraisal.zh: 卡斯特罗是复杂而矛盾的历史人物：他结束巴蒂斯塔独裁统治，推行社会改革使古巴的教育与医疗在拉美名列前茅，并以反帝立场成为第三世界反抗西方霸权的象征，常与切·格瓦拉并提。然而另一种看法认为，他建立的是高度集权的独裁政权，取缔反对派、实行一党制、压制言论与新闻自由，经济长期困难，个人崇拜盛行，其形象也由革命英雄转为独裁者。
appraisal.en: Castro is a complex and contradictory figure: he ended the Batista dictatorship, carried out social reforms that placed Cuba's education and healthcare among Latin America's best, and as an anti-imperialist became a symbol of third-world resistance to Western hegemony, often named alongside Che Guevara. Yet another view holds that he built a highly centralized dictatorship, banning opposition, imposing one-party rule and suppressing free speech and press, presiding over lasting economic hardship and a cult of personality, his image shifting from revolutionary hero to dictator.

supporter.zh: 支持者视卡斯特罗为古巴革命的伟大领袖和民族英雄。他结束了巴蒂斯塔独裁统治，实现了古巴的民族独立和社会正义。卡斯特罗推行的一系列社会改革使古巴的教育和医疗水平在拉丁美洲名列前茅，大幅提高了普通民众的生活质量。他坚持反帝国主义立场，维护了古巴的主权和尊严，成为第三世界国家反抗西方霸权的象征。他的革命精神和社会理想激励了全球许多追求正义和平等的人们。
supporter.en: Supporters view Castro as a great revolutionary leader and national hero who ended the Batista dictatorship and achieved Cuban national independence and social justice. The series of social reforms he implemented made Cuba's education and healthcare systems among the best in Latin America, significantly improving the quality of life for ordinary people. He maintained an anti-imperialist stance, safeguarding Cuba's sovereignty and dignity, and became a symbol of resistance against Western hegemony for third-world countries. His revolutionary spirit and social ideals have inspired people worldwide who seek justice and equality.

critic.zh: 批评者指责卡斯特罗建立了独裁政权，压制了公民自由和政治多元化。他上台后取缔了所有反对派，建立了单一政党制度，限制了言论自由和新闻自由。古巴的经济政策导致长期的经济困难和物资短缺，人民生活水平长期停滞。卡斯特罗还支持了多个国家的军事干预，导致地区冲突和人道主义危机。批评者认为，尽管他声称追求社会正义，但实际上建立了一个高度集权的国家机器，个人崇拜盛行，违背了他最初宣称的革命理想。
critic.en: Critics accuse Castro of establishing a dictatorial regime that suppressed civil liberties and political pluralism. After taking power, he banned all opposition parties, established a one-party system, and restricted freedom of speech and press. Cuba's economic policies led to long-term economic difficulties and material shortages, with living standards stagnating for decades. Castro also supported military interventions in multiple countries, causing regional conflicts and humanitarian crises. Critics argue that despite his claims of pursuing social justice, he actually created a highly centralized state apparatus with widespread cult of personality, betraying the revolutionary ideals he initially professed.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，卡斯特罗是一个复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是反殖民和反帝国主义的象征，也是冷战时期东西方对抗的关键人物。在拉丁美洲，他被视为反抗美国霸权的标志性人物，其形象经常与切·格瓦拉等革命者并列。在全球流行文化中，卡斯特罗的形象经历了从革命英雄到独裁者的转变，反映了不同时代和不同政治立场的人们对他的解读。他的政治遗产至今仍在古巴和世界范围内引发争议，成为研究20世纪政治史和革命运动的重要案例。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Castro is a complex and contradictory historical figure. He is both a symbol of anti-colonial and anti-imperialist struggle and a key figure in the East-West confrontation during the Cold War. In Latin America, he is regarded as an iconic figure resisting US hegemony, often mentioned alongside revolutionaries like Che Guevara. In global popular culture, Castro's image has evolved from revolutionary hero to dictator, reflecting interpretations by people from different eras and political perspectives. His political legacy continues to spark controversy in Cuba and worldwide, serving as an important case study for studying 20th-century political history and revolutionary movements.
